method: Read-only saved checkpoints, receipts, byte hashes, AST equivalence and HTTP log counts; no model, test, grade, HTTP or process execution.
limitations: Development and fresh final phases stay separate; the initial admission-blocked block is not pooled.
Regions changes workflow, source representation, static regression admission and host checks as a bundle; no isolated component or training effect is measured.
Same caps/model/fixtures do not imply identical requests or identical check counts.
Only one development pair was usable in both arms; its task times exclude independent grading and are not a broad speed benchmark.
The fresh-final region attempt was canceled under critical memory pressure and not graded; two final arms were never started.
Canceled HTTP attempts can lack response usage; health and local cancellation do not prove the external model is idle.
Resource baselines are shared within each separately declared phase, not one common startup-inclusive baseline across both phases.
The authored differential static gate rejected a genuine assigned-result assertion; its post-freeze CPU fix does not change these saved scores.
Failed partial source implementations remain visible; oracle pass alone is not verified task completion.
Small synthetic one-trial cases do not establish broad repository quality or Codex parity.
